entries.description: Per-sample actor-critic objective from selected-action log probabilities, detached advantages and returns, value predictions, and policy entropies; rollout and distribution calculations remain caller-owned.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def rollouts(ctx):
    state = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    action = int(ctx.index) % 2
    advantage = float(int(ctx.index) % 5 - 2)
    returns = float(int(ctx.index) % 3 - 1)
    inputs = torch.cat((state, torch.tensor([float(action)])))
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(inputs), "advantage": synth.Tensor(torch.tensor(advantage)), "returns": synth.Tensor(torch.tensor(returns))}
class ActorCritic(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=3)
    def forward(self, inputs):
        raw = self.network(inputs[..., :4])
        log_probabilities = torch.log_softmax(raw[..., :2], dim=-1)
        actions = inputs[..., 4].long().unsqueeze(-1)
        log_probability = log_probabilities.gather(-1, actions).squeeze(-1)
        probabilities = log_probabilities.exp()
        entropy = -(probabilities * log_probabilities).sum(dim=-1)
        return {"log_probability": log_probability, "value": raw[..., 2], "entropy": entropy}
ds = synth.Spec("a2c-rollouts", generator=rollouts, size=12, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
trainer = Trainer(ActorCritic(), train, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "a2c", "loss_kwargs": {"entropy_coefficient": 0.01, "reduction": "mean"}, "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "log_probability"}, "targets": {"batch": "advantage"}, "value": {"output": "value"}, "returns": {"batch": "returns"}, "entropy": {"output": "entropy"}}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()

import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    image = torch.rand((1, 16, 16), generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    mask = torch.zeros((16, 16), dtype=torch.bool)
    mask[5:11, 5:11] = True
    outside = F.max_pool2d((~mask).float()[None, None], 3, stride=1, padding=1)[0, 0] > 0
    boundary = mask & outside
    rows, columns = torch.meshgrid(torch.arange(16), torch.arange(16), indexing="ij")
    points = torch.stack((rows, columns), dim=-1).reshape(-1, 2).float()
    boundary_points = points[boundary.reshape(-1)]
    distances = torch.cdist(points, boundary_points).min(dim=1).values.reshape(16, 16)
    signed_distance = torch.where(mask, -distances, distances).unsqueeze(0)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(image), "distance": synth.Tensor(signed_distance)}
ds = synth.Spec("boundary-segmentation", generator=samples, size=8, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
class ForegroundModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = build("unet", "tiny", in_channels=1, out_channels=1, features=[4, 8])
    def forward(self, inputs):
        return {"probabilities": self.network(inputs).sigmoid()}
trainer = Trainer(ForegroundModel(), train, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "boundary-loss", "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "probabilities"}, "targets": {"batch": "distance"}}}, batch_size=2, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()

import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    label = int(ctx.index) % 3
    features = 0.1 * torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    features[label] += 1.0
    return {"features": synth.Tensor(features), "labels": label}
ds = synth.Spec("cosface-classification", generator=samples, size=24, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
class CosFaceClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=4)
        self.class_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(3, 4))
    def forward(self, features):
        embeddings = F.normalize(self.encoder(features), dim=-1)
        class_weights = F.normalize(self.class_weights, dim=-1)
        return F.linear(embeddings, class_weights)
trainer = Trainer(CosFaceClassifier(), train, recipe="tabular-classify", recipe_config={"loss": "cosface", "loss_kwargs": {"margin": 0.35, "scale": 64.0}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()

import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, analysis, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def train_case(name, size, shift, size_change, batch_size):
    @synth.generator
    def samples(ctx):
        index = int(ctx.index)
        inputs = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
        x1 = 0.1 + (index % 3) * shift
        y1 = 0.15 + (index % 4) * shift
        width = 0.5 + (index % 2) * size_change
        height = 0.6 + (index % 3) * size_change
        targets = torch.tensor([x1, y1, x1 + width, y1 + height]).unsqueeze(0)
        return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(inputs), "targets": synth.Tensor(targets)}
    dataset = synth.Spec(name, generator=samples, size=size, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
    train = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
    val = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="val", like=train)
    class BoxPredictor(nn.Module):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__()
            self.network = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=4)
        def forward(self, inputs):
            raw = self.network(inputs)
            lower = raw[..., :2].sigmoid()
            upper = lower + torch.nn.functional.softplus(raw[..., 2:]) + 0.01
            return {"boxes": torch.cat((lower, upper), dim=-1).unsqueeze(-2)}
    model = BoxPredictor()
    trainer = Trainer(model, train, val, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "eiou", "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "boxes"}, "targets": {"batch": "targets"}}}, batch_size=batch_size, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
    trainer.fit()
    metrics = trainer.evaluate(val)
    assert all(torch.isfinite(torch.tensor(value)) for value in metrics.values())
    return analysis.analyze(model)
tiny_report = train_case("eiou-tiny-boxes", 4, 0.0, 0.0, 1)
small_report = train_case("eiou-small-boxes", 12, 0.02, 0.05, 4)

import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def paired_views(ctx):
    label = int(ctx.index) % 2
    center = torch.zeros(6)
    center[label] = 1.0
    first = center + 0.05 * torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    second = center + 0.05 * torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(torch.stack((first, second))), "targets": label}
dataset = synth.Spec("supcon-paired-views", generator=paired_views, size=16, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
class Projector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=8)
    def forward(self, inputs):
        batch_size, view_count, feature_count = inputs.shape
        flat = inputs.reshape(batch_size * view_count, feature_count)
        embeddings = self.network(flat).reshape(batch_size, view_count, -1)
        return {"embeddings": embeddings}
trainer = Trainer(Projector(), train, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "supcon", "loss_kwargs": {"temperature": 0.1}, "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "embeddings"}, "targets": {"batch": "targets"}}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
